# Mail the low-stock report every Monday

## Problem

The clerks open the low-stock report by hand. They want it mailed.

## Users

The 3 shift leads get the e-mail.

## Goals

- The low-stock report is mailed every Monday to the 3 shift leads.

## Non-goals

- Other reports.

## Success measures

- The mail reaches 95% of the 3 shift leads within 10 minutes.

## Open questions

- Which time on Monday does the mail go out?
